about: Inkling-2-Mini (26B looped MoE, vision, thinking) at a 397,312-token context on one RTX 3090 24GB with every expert in VRAM: maya-ik2 (alesha-pro/maya-inkling-mini cc41ab1, a CUDA engine for this model) plus a local patch (host-RAM conversation slots, mid-prompt snapshots, a start-plan reserve knob, and K1b-K13 CUDA kernel/graph optimizations). Weights: unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL with the experts of blocks 20-23 requantized Q8_0 -> NVFP4 (the other 20 blocks are NVFP4 as released; 1.9 GiB less, KL 0.001-0.002 against the original, below the FP8 KV cache's ~0.01). FP8 KV, the official DSpark drafter (16K context, windows up to 8), the vision encoder on the CPU, one slot. Measured: 136.7 tok/s prose / 291.1 code at a short context, 1157 tok/s prefill at 378K tokens, 113.0 tok/s median (111.4 mean, up to 149.4 code) at 378K; 845 GB/s global FP8 attention @393K; needles 3/3 at 395K.
setup: BUILD: docs/rtx3090-inkling-2-mini-maya-ik2-388k/build.sh does all of it in an empty directory and leaves maya-inkling-mini/ as the working directory: clone at cc41ab1, git apply maya-ik2-session2-k13-full.patch, build maya-ik2 (sm_86) and maya-vision (llama.cpp b12590), extract the tokenizer, download the pinned weights, write models/Inkling-2-Mini-UD-Q4_K_XL-nvfp4tail.gguf with requant.py (sha256 ee205a600be110910ae0b94d88a5b3671d2f2440dda36f5d282e7c82311db651) and copy ik2-388k.json (the server config: engine flags and env) into docs/inkling2-mini/. Measured with CUDA 12.x, driver 615.78, on a card that also drives a desktop (~0.36 GB): peak 23.9 GB. NEEDS: the whole 24 GB card; a program holding ~0.2 GB more makes the engine fall back to experts in host memory (it prints the safe --max-context). One slot: other requests queue; a side request keeps the long chat in a host-RAM slot (IK2_SLOTS 4 x up to 16 GB total).
